name: Axis USD
oneLiner: USDx is Axis's synthetic dollar, backed by venue-held assets and market-neutral hedges; approved counterparties redeem through signed orders.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The canonical Ethereum V2 USDx token is a synthetic dollar backed by stablecoins and liquid assets deployed at trading venues, with directional inventory offset by hedges. The official reserve documentation explicitly describes delta-neutral exposure and offchain venue custody; it does not establish measured hedge coverage. Axis dates the first USDx tranche to April 8, 2026; the legacy Plasma V1 token records that 10,000,000 USDx tranche minted between blocks 18603490 and 18607789 on April 7, 2026 UTC. The current canonical V2 implementation launched on July 23, so its mechanism history does not inherit the private-beta product age.

sources.label: Axis dates first USDx issuance to April 8, 2026
Legacy Plasma V1 first-tranche mint completion, April 7, 2026

collateral: Issuer gross asset-form snapshot dated October 15, 2026: liquid hedge inventory 75.83%, stablecoins and settlement tokens 18.13%, yield-bearing and staked collateral 4.50%, tokenized Treasuries or reserve-backed cash equivalents 0.89%, and fiat cash and FX balances 0.64% (display-rounded; reserves sidecar retains exact source weights). Gross shares precede hedge offsets. The issuer marks 44.9659% of the whole book unclassified within liquid inventory; constituent identities, dependency weights and canonical V2-versus-legacy reserve partition remain unresolved.
pegMechanism: Approved primary-market accounts sign EIP-712 orders against USDC or USDT collateral; authorized operators settle minting and redemption atomically onchain. Offchain RFQ pricing reflects portfolio unwind costs, and the contract does not independently value collateral using an external oracle. Retail holders rely on secondary markets. Indicative instant and seven-day redemption bands are not committed capacity or settlement guarantees.

proofOfReserves.provider: Accountable read-only venue-account and cryptographic reserve verification; not a signed financial audit or proof of hedge coverage, legal segregation or insolvency priority

notices.title: Primary redemption is restricted and has no modeled capacity
notices.message: Direct USDx redemption requires an approved primary-market account and an operator-settled signed order. Public instant and seven-day scenarios are indicative, not committed capacity or settlement guarantees. Pharos does not model an issuer redemption backstop without executable RFQ capacity; other holders rely on secondary markets.
